stage.name: Simulated Assassination-4
stage.description:
Condition:
5 tiles on the battlefield are no longer available for deployment.

zone.name: You the Constant, You Are Me

flying_boots_elite_mercenary.name: 'Flying Boots' Elite Mercenary
flying_boots_elite_mercenary.flavourText: Mercenaries propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet. Their favorite targets are Ursus convoys and their simple, durable Ursine products.
abilities: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

pothelm_arbalest.name: 'Pothelm' Arbalest
pothelm_arbalest.flavourText: Well-equipped mercenaries with a Victorian lens on their helms. Thanks to how well their helms block out sound, they have never heard the snickers of other Scar Market mercs behind their backs.

deathveil_assassin.name: Deathveil Assassin
deathveil_assassin.flavourText: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.
abilities: Invisible; the next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage.
Temporarily loses Invisibility, Physical dodge, and Arts dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.
Can pass through a blocking unit once when HP drops to below 50%.

bounty_hunter_grand_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Grand Knight'
bounty_hunter_grand_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, aspiring to join the Kazimierzian knight competitions once they've saved enough money. For now, their greatest joy remains tormenting their targets as they hunt them down.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

weaver.name: 'Weaver'
weaver.flavourText: Mercenaries who expertly wield the latest equipment. Their mastery of the blades is so deep that they can operate a loom with them.
abilities: Attacks also deal splash damage to allied units in 4 adjacent tiles.

enraged_spatula_giant.name: Enraged Spatula Giant
enraged_spatula_giant.flavourText: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, seeking to dice and slice with Lateran kitchen utensils.
abilities: Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.name: Rogue Mercenary 'Lead Guitar'
rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.flavourText: Metal band members who seamlessly blend their mercenary and performer careers. Their torrential rhythms are powerful enough to melt faces—literally.
abilities: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.
